source_title: World Iran’s Mojtaba Khamenei Warns US, Israel Against Fresh Attacks, Orders Immediate Response
source_excerpt:
Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei has warned the United States and Israel against launching fresh attacks on the country, saying Iran's armed forces and people would decide when and how to respond if hostilities resume.
“If the enemies once again launch military or terrorist attacks, it is the armed forces of the Islamic Republic and the Iranian nation that will determine the time and conditions for ending them,” a statement attributed to Khamenei and published on his website on Saturday said, AFP reported.
The warning comes amid threats from Washington and Tel Aviv of a possible resumption of military strikes against Iran.
According to the statement, Khamenei directed military commanders to ensure that “any level or type of threat must be met with an immediate, impactful and geographically unrestricted response”.
The statement followed a reported meeting between Khamenei and senior military commanders. It was the first reported meeting between the Iranian leader and the country's military leadership, the report said.
Khamenei also ordered the commanders to revise Iran's target list to include “all types of tangible and intangible assets belonging to the American-Zionist enemy”.
Meanwhile, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi said on Saturday that Tehran had examined a message from US Vice President JD Vance and discussed it during high-level meetings.
Speaking to Al Jazeera, Araqchi outlined Iran's conditions for resuming negotiations with Washington. These included lifting sanctions imposed after the Islamabad memorandum of understanding (MOU) and reducing the US military presence in the region.
He also said reopening the Strait of Hormuz on Tehran's terms would create conditions for talks with the United States to resume.
US President Donald Trump said on Friday that he expected the war with Iran to end soon, although he did not explain how that would happen.
“It's going to get wrapped up soon. We need a guarantee there'll never be a nuclear weapon,” Trump said in an interview with Kansas City's KCMO Talk Radio station, Reuters reported.
However, on October 24, Trump had hinted at the possibility of renewed military action against Iran as early as Sunday, while also leaving room for a diplomatic agreement.
Tehran, meanwhile, denied reports that it had offered to reopen the strategically important Strait of Hormuz in exchange for Washington lifting its naval blockade.
Speaking to reporters after casting his ballot in Florida, Trump said Iran wanted a deal to reopen the waterway but questioned whether Tehran would honour any agreement.
“Do you really think I would tell you that? Maybe tomorrow... There's a possibility I will. There's also a possibility we'll have a nice, big, beautiful agreement,” Trump said when asked about the possibility of fresh strikes.
His remarks come amid continuing tensions between Washington and Tehran, with Trump repeatedly shifting his position on the prospect of renewed military action against Iran.
Washington and Tehran have remained locked in a war-like situation since February 28, when the United States and Israel launched joint strikes on Iran.
The conflict disrupted regional security, threatened global energy supplies and brought shipping through the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz to a near standstill.
Iran's Foreign Minister outlined that talks could resume if sanctions imposed after the Islamabad MOU are lifted and the US reduces its military presence. Reopening the Strait of Hormuz on Tehran's terms is also a condition.
Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei warned the US and Israel that Iran's forces would determine the response time and conditions if new attacks occur. He also ordered commanders to ensure an immediate, impactful, and unrestricted retaliation.
President Trump indicated the conflict could end soon, emphasizing a guarantee against nuclear weapons. While hinting at potential new strikes, he also left open the possibility of a diplomatic agreement.
The current war-like situation began on February 28 after the United States and Israel launched joint strikes on Iran. This conflict disrupted regional security and threatened global energy supplies.

## पश्चिम एशिया में तनाव और ताजा बयानबाजी

समाचार एजेंसी एएफपी की रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, ईरान के शीर्ष नेता मोजतबा खामेनेई ने शनिवार को अपनी वेबसाइट पर जारी एक बयान में अमेरिका और इजराइल को नए हमलों के खिलाफ चेतावनी दी है। यह चेतावनी ऐसे समय में आई है जब वाशिंगटन और तेल अवीव की ओर से ईरान पर संभावित सैन्य हमलों की आशंका जताई जा रही है।

रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, खामेनेई ने सैन्य कमांडरों के साथ एक बैठक में निर्देश दिए हैं कि किसी भी प्रकार के खतरे का तुरंत और प्रभावशाली जवाब दिया जाना चाहिए। इसके साथ ही उन्होंने अमेरिकी और इजरायली संपत्तियों को लेकर सैन्य रणनीतियों की समीक्षा करने के भी आदेश दिए हैं।

## कूटनीतिक मोर्चे पर बातचीत और शर्तें

इस बीच, ईरानी विदेश मंत्री अब्बास अराकची ने शनिवार को अल जजीरा को दिए साक्षात्कार में कहा कि तेहरान ने अमेरिकी नेतृत्व के संदेश का अध्ययन किया है। अराकची ने अमेरिका के साथ बातचीत फिर से शुरू करने के लिए कुछ शर्तें रखी हैं, जिनमें प्रमुख रूप से प्रतिबंधों को हटाना और क्षेत्र में अमेरिकी सैन्य उपस्थिति को कम करना शामिल है।

## अमेरिकी प्रतिक्रिया और स्थिति

दूसरी ओर, अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रम्प ने शुक्रवार को एक रेडियो साक्षात्कार में कहा कि उन्हें उम्मीद है कि ईरान के साथ चल रहा संघर्ष जल्द ही समाप्त हो जाएगा। हालांकि, उन्होंने यह भी संकेत दिया कि परमाणु हथियारों को रोकने के लिए गारंटी की आवश्यकता है। ट्रम्प ने पूर्व में संभावित सैन्य कार्रवाई और कूटनीतिक समझौतों दोनों की संभावनाओं का जिक्र किया है।

## मुख्य बातें

- **ईरान की चेतावनी:** यदि नए हमले होते हैं, तो ईरान के सशस्त्र बल और जनता प्रतिक्रिया की शर्तें तय करेगी।
- **सैन्य निर्देश:** कमांडरों को किसी भी खतरे का तुरंत और प्रभावी जवाब देने का आदेश दिया गया है।
- **बातचीत की शर्तें:** ईरान ने प्रतिबंध हटाने और अमेरिकी सैन्य मौजूदगी कम करने जैसी शर्तें रखी हैं।
- **तनाव की पृष्ठभूमि:** 28 फरवरी से अमेरिका और इजराइल के संयुक्त हमलों के बाद से दोनों पक्षों के बीच तनावपूर्ण स्थिति बनी हुई है।

मूल घोषणाओं और आधिकारिक बयानों की सत्यता की पुष्टि के लिए संबंधित देशों के आधिकारिक सरकारी पोर्टलों और अंतरराष्ट्रीय समाचार एजेंसियों की रिपोर्टों का अवलोकन किया जा सकता है।

en_body:
## Recent Warnings and Military Directives

Iran's leadership has issued fresh warnings to the United States and Israel following reports of a meeting between senior military commanders and Iranian leadership. According to published statements attributed to Iranian authorities, military commanders were instructed to prepare immediate and geographically unrestricted responses to any renewed military or terrorist actions.

Reports indicate that directives were also given to revise target lists to encompass tangible and intangible assets associated with adversaries. These developments coincide with ongoing discussions regarding regional security and maritime transit routes.

## Diplomatic Positions and Conditions for Talks

Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi stated that Tehran had reviewed communications from US officials and discussed them in high-level meetings. According to reported remarks:

* Talks could resume if sanctions implemented following the Islamabad memorandum of understanding are lifted.
* Iran seeks a reduction in the US military presence within the region.
* Reopening the Strait of Hormuz on Tehran's terms has been cited as a factor in creating conditions for potential negotiations.

Concurrently, denials were issued by Tehran regarding claims that an offer had already been made to reopen the Strait of Hormuz in exchange for the lifting of naval blockades.

## US Statements and Context

United States leadership has expressed expectations that the conflict might conclude soon, while emphasizing the requirement for guarantees preventing nuclear weapons development. Public statements from Washington have alternated between suggestions of potential diplomatic agreements and hints at the possibility of renewed military actions.

The ongoing conflict, which escalated following joint strikes by the US and Israel, has continued to impact regional security, global energy supplies, and commercial shipping through vital waterways.

## How to Verify

Readers seeking to verify developments can monitor official statements from the Iranian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, press briefings from the White House, and official reports from international news agencies monitoring regional updates.
